sections.heading: Do British citizens need a Benin visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Benin, and can apply online for an eVisa before travelling.

sections.heading: Benin visa for other passport holders
sections.text: UK residents on other passports usually apply the same way. The eVisa is linked to your passport, so travel on the passport you used to apply.

sections.heading: Before you travel to Benin
sections.text: Check whether you need a yellow fever vaccination certificate, as many West African countries ask for one on arrival. Print or save your eVisa approval to show at the border.

sections.heading: Benin visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Benin visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. We check the current rules for your nationality, complete your application and keep you updated until it's approved. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Benin.

faqs.q: Do I need a visa for Benin from the UK?
faqs.a: Yes, British citizens need a visa. You can apply online for an eVisa before you travel.

faqs.q: How long does a Benin eVisa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days. Apply at least a week before you travel.

faqs.q: Can you apply for my Benin visa for me?
faqs.a: Yes. Use our online form: upload your passport and we fill in your details, then we complete and check the Benin visa application and submit it for you.
